audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Warwick levels 2, 3, first item and two items, while the matching whys say Sylas sets the trade pattern at 2, wins every extended fight at 3, out-trades him after Riftmaker, and that Warwick 'has no hard scaling win condition'. Packet chart reads Skill, Sylas, Sylas, Sylas, Sylas, Sylas, Skill on a 54.9% (386 games) matchup.
audit.why: Warwick's only lane advantage is level 1, before Sylas has E. Once E is up, Sylas dictates when the fight starts, and at 6 a stolen Infinite Duress costs him nothing while Warwick's own is 110 seconds.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-5 flipped to Sylas and row 6 to Skill in both layers, ratings rescaled.

audit.why: Four spikes: level 2 E, level 6 Hijacked Infinite Duress, Riftmaker, and the late-game shift where his R stops being decisive. Timings are right.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four problems. (a) 'Land E to stun him' and 'stun him into a W all-in' — Sylas's E has no CC at all; the recast only pulls him to the target. (b) 'His Blood Hunt passive' in two places — Blood Hunt is his W; the passive is Eternal Hunger. (c) Infinite Duress called a 'fifteen-second invitation' when it is 110/90/70. (d) Primal Howl (E) is not mentioned anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Primal Howl is the single ability most likely to break a Sylas all-in — 2.5 seconds of damage reduction that ends in a 1-second fear, so a W spent early is wasted twice over. And a player told E stuns will chain a combo that never locks Warwick down.
audit.corrected: Stun claims removed and replaced with the real sequencing off his 8-second Q cooldown; Blood Hunt correctly labelled W and Eternal Hunger named as the passive; Infinite Duress stated at 110 seconds; Primal Howl written into the interactions and the mid text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal appears only as a trailing clause in the itemization line, and the page never says that raw HP is the wrong stat here.
audit.why: Eternal Hunger heals him below 50% health and triples the healing below 25%; Jaws of the Beast deals damage based on the target's maximum health and heals for it. Stacking HP feeds his Q and stacking nothing at all feeds his passive — Grievous Wounds is the actual answer.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds made explicit in whys[2] and wants.you[2], with the percent-max-health bite named.

audit.why: Packet flagged wants.foe[1] 'Use Infinite Duress' as a suspect name; it is his real R. False positive.

edits.before: At level 1 Warwick's Q is his whole game — he dives in, heals, and resets the aggression. You have no E yet, so respect the range: last-hit with Q and avoid letting him nose-dive onto you with a clean Q heal at low HP. The moment you hit level 2 everything changes. E gives you the hook to interrupt his Q animation mid-cast, cancelling the heal and pulling yourself directly onto him for a W burst. Start with this pattern every trade and he cannot sustain through it.
edits.after: At level 1 Warwick's Q is his whole game — he lunges, bites for a share of your max health, heals off it, and resets the aggression. You have no E yet, so respect the range: last-hit with Q and never let him nose-dive you at low HP, since Eternal Hunger heals him harder the lower he drops. The moment you hit level 2 everything changes. E closes on his 8-second Q cooldown and pulls you onto him for the W burst before he can lunge again. Run that pattern every trade and he cannot sustain through it.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are your bully window. His Blood Hunt passive makes him faster onto low-HP targets, so keep your HP above half if you back off — but in an all-in YOU want to burn him low first with chain Q procs and Passive autos, then W for the executed heal. At 6 this matchup swings hard in your favour: steal Infinite Duress, then immediately all-in. He has no suppress to open with and you do. Land E to stun him, blow the stolen R to lock him down, W for the kill.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are your bully window. Blood Hunt (W) makes him faster onto anyone under half HP, so keep your own bar above that when you disengage — but in an all-in you want him low first, with chain Q procs and passive autos, then W. At 6 this swings hard your way: steal Infinite Duress and all-in, because his own is 110 seconds and yours is not. Expect Primal Howl — 2.5 seconds of damage reduction ending in a fear — so hold W until that howl is spent, then E2 in and cash the stolen R.

edits.before: Full kit access and W sustain let you win every extended fight; chain Passive autos reset between spells and out-damage his drain at equal HP.
edits.after: Full kit and W sustain win the extended fight, but Jaws of the Beast bites for a share of your max health — stacking HP feeds it, Grievous Wounds answers it.

edits.before: Hook him mid-Q animation with E to interrupt his heal and stun him into a W all-in
edits.after: Hook with E2 on his 8-second Q cooldown, before he can lunge and heal off you again

edits.before: Stack Riftmaker omnivamp in extended trades so your W heal outpaces his passive drain
edits.after: Carry Grievous Wounds — Eternal Hunger triples his healing under 25% and undoes your burst

edits.before: E comes online — hook him through his Q wind-up and W into him before his Blood Hunt passive can close the gap.
edits.after: E comes online — punish the 8-second gap after his Q lunge and W into him before Blood Hunt (W) closes the distance.

edits.before: Warwick burns Infinite Duress on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Warwick burns Infinite Duress on nothing — that is a 110-second invitation.

edits.before: Track Warwick’s Infinite Duress: Lock-on suppress — track it before every step-up. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Track Infinite Duress, a 110s suppress — and Primal Howl, 2.5s of damage reduction that ends in a fear.

notes: Primal Howl (E) was entirely absent from this page and it is the ability that most often makes a correctly-counted Sylas all-in fail: damage reduction for 2.5 seconds followed by a fear. Also removed two claims that Sylas's E stuns — it has no CC in Riot's text — and corrected Blood Hunt from 'passive' to W in two places. I did not assert anything about whether Infinite Duress can be cleansed or QSS'd, or whether Sylas's E can interrupt Jaws of the Beast; the kit files do not contain that and I did not verify it.
